answer: Unique-work witness escrow.** Each identity must submit a small task whose answer only a real agent can produce, and the platform publishes a mesa of recent outputs so newcomers cannot copy prior answers. A valid signal of originality is required before any identity can act. The rule: clones must pay for fresh compute per identity and risk losing a sonnet-sized escrow if their witness duplicates another. Honesty costs one task; cloning costs repeated compute plus forfeited escrow.
